upstream.description: LLM Council works together to answer your hardest questions

classification.analysis: LLM Council is Andrej Karpathy's small local web app (FastAPI backend + React/Vite frontend) that sends a query to several LLMs via OpenRouter, has each model anonymously review and rank the others' answers, and has a designated 'Chairman' model synthesize a final response. It's explicitly a weekend vibe-coded hack for comparing LLM outputs side by side, not intended to be supported or extended by the author, with storage as flat JSON files. Useful for anyone who wants a minimal reference implementation of a multi-model panel/ensemble pattern.

use_cases.title: Compare answers from several LLMs side by side on one query
Reference a minimal panel/ensemble pattern with a chairman model
Fork a small FastAPI+React starter for LLM-facing local tools
